versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules

selection1:

selection2:
  ParentImage: '*\svchost.exe*'

    - '*net.exe view'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: CommandLine="*\\svchost.exe C:\\Users\*\\Desktop\*" OR (ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe*" CommandLine IN ("*whoami.exe /all", "*net.exe view"))

versions.subject: feat: multiple updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_svchost:
    Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'C:\Users\'
        - '\Desktop\'
filter_svchost:
    ParentImage|startswith: 'C:\Windows\System32\'
selection_regsvr:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\excel.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\regsvr32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -s '
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
filter_regsvr:
    CommandLine|contains: '.dll'
selection_anomaly_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
selection_anomaly_child_1:
    Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' /all'
selection_anomaly_child_2:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' view'
condition: (selection_svchost and not filter_svchost) or (selection_regsvr and not filter_regsvr) or (selection_anomaly_parent and 1 of selection_anomaly_child_*)
versions.spl: (Image="*\\svchost.exe" CommandLine="*C:\\Users\\*" CommandLine="*\\Desktop\\*" NOT ParentImage="C:\\Windows\\System32\\*") OR (ParentImage="*\\excel.exe" Image="*\\regsvr32.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -s *", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*") NOT CommandLine="*.dll*") OR (ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe" (Image="*\\whoami.exe" CommandLine="* /all*") OR (Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="* view*"))
